title: Trump Denies Directing Cohen to Break Campaign-Finance Laws (Wall Street Journal)
text: Ime Archibong / Facebook : An Update on Our App Investigation — Today we banned myPersonality — an app that was mainly active prior to 2012 — from Facebook for failing to agree to our request to audit and because it's clear that they shared information with researchers as well as companies with only limited protections in place. Christopher Hooks / GQ : Beto O'Rourke vs. Ted Cruz and the Fight for America — Down in deep-red Texas, a fresh-faced liberal named Beto O'Rourke has a shot at beating Ted Cruz. But huge as that would be, the race has grander implications: It helps explain all the giddy hopes and secret fears of Democrats everywhere.
